detail: Decisions: Chose to land the uncommitted programme-log entries (D22–D38) as a standalone chore commit before merging any lane, rather than folding them into the first merge commit — a merge commit should carry only the merge, so the audit trail stays readable and a bad merge can be reset without losing the log
summary: Merge integration start: committed the pending D22–D38 programme-log entries and .twining archiver churn so foundation/v3 is clean before the five-lane merge.
